title: Collaboration
intro: Exchange encrypted review files with verified collaborators. Files contain the selected saved record text; linked media and evidence files are not included.
witnessed: I witnessed the work described in this record
enable: Enable Collaboration in Preferences to exchange review files.
identityHelp: Send this public contact file to your collaborator. Compare the full fingerprint over an independent trusted channel before accepting it.
chooseContact: Choose a public contact file to inspect its fingerprint.
verifiedContact: I compared the complete fingerprint with this person through another trusted channel.
importHelp: Verify the sender in Contacts first. The file must be addressed to this installation.
contactFirst: Add a verified reviewer contact first.
sharingHelp: The encrypted file shares the selected saved records with this reviewer, including private text. Linked files and other records are excluded. Up to 50 records and 750 KB per request.
selectionHelp: Preview the saved record titles and revisions before creating the request.
readHelp: These are the exact saved records sent by your collaborator. Linked evidence and media are not included. A review does not establish physical execution or measurement accuracy.
confirm: I reviewed these saved revisions and intend to sign the decisions above.
timeHelp: Signing time comes from this computer. A signature verifies the key and unchanged content; it is not an independent timestamp.
workspaceChanged: The active workspace changed. Reopen reviews.
fileSize: Choose a file within the allowed size.
saveFirst: Save or discard your record edits before requesting review.
previewFirst: Preview the selection before creating the request.
pageChanged: The review list changed. Refresh it to continue browsing.
